claims.label: bsr-associated blasticidin S inactivation in the source-reported bacterial isolate
claims.note: Native source isolate identified phenotypically in the historical study, not re-identified genomically. Deamination is distinct from chemical isomerization. The claim concerns the blasticidin S moiety, not equivalence of salt forms.
